mid.name: Fortitude
mid.annotation: Very fast, very 4.8k, very heal. In actuality, this is mostly a roaming and sustain item, you should sell it second after trophy collector for other damage items. //4.8k spike.

mid.name: Tankbuster
mid.annotation: Massive 3 damage, try to play around the cooldown, 3's cooldown starts ticking as soon as you start charging it, so you can wait for the very last second with no downtime.

mid.name: Express Shot
mid.annotation: Testing has shown that this item outperforms Hollow Point for sniping, because of the large added damage to your shots, but unfortunately Carbine only gets the smaller secondary fire damage buff.

mid.name: Hollow Point
mid.annotation: Good damage and the effect procks with carbine, so your target will lose resists and be easier to kill for you or your team, but it depends on your health and has ever so slightly worse snipes.

mid.name: Stamina Mastery
mid.annotation: You can't not have Stamina Mastery in any build ever. If you feel you don't need it, swap it out Ultra Late for a t4 green of your choice.

late.name: Mystic Reverb
late.annotation: This is literally just 50% more damage, and the aoe will easily deal thousands of damage in teamfights.

late.name: Crippling Headshot
late.annotation: It's mostly useful in longer fights, not as good for pure sniping, still, has massive value in teamfights, try to go for headshots if your too far away to target one person.

late.name: Glass Cannon
late.annotation: Highest gun damage item in the game, and since our playstyle is so safe its incredibly easy to stack.

late.name: Spirit Burn

late.annotation: This finishes our spirit investment after buying Mercurial Magnum, buying it before then isn't usually optimal.// With the increased movespeed spirit scaling change this is now viable earlier.
